what_happened: All thirteen target declarations (P8 pair, the eleven Pthm principles, plus two reusable helpers) were elaborated end-to-end in a single lean_run_code probe against the live built environment: success=true, zero sorry, only a longLine lint warning. The implementation phase therefore starts from verified proof terms rather than sketches.

DELIVER item (4) of the task description states 'Pthm:18 from Pthm:15 and Pthm:14 ... exactly as the cut proofs do', but the cut file's own proof of Pthm:18 is direct (P1, MN/MK, MT/M5/MK) and does not route through Pthm:15 or Pthm:14. The 15+14 route is the cut file's HEADER redundancy note, not its derivation. Item (4) also asks for Pthm:17 from Pthm:11 and Pthm:16, which is moot since perpetuity4 already proves it independently and item (3) forbids restating it.

P8 cannot 'follow the proof shape' of temporalDualityNeg/Rev as the task asks: because the tree defines sometimes as the dual (sometimes phi = (always phi.neg).neg) rather than the paper's disjunction, P8 is definitionally double-negation at always(neg phi) -- doubleNegation and notNotIntro one-liners -- whereas P7 genuinely needs alwaysDni/alwaysDne. The honest precedent is fNegG/pNegH in TemporalDerived, which are likewise bare notNotIntro.

Plan-time re-probe of all 16 target declarations under their FINAL names via lean_run_code returned success:true with ZERO diagnostics (research's probe had one longLine warning, fixed by wrapping). The plan's Lean Challenge Statements are plan-time-derived, not carried-unverified.
